results.title: Goldmine
results.overview: Singer Lorelai's father suffers a heart attack and is placed on VR life support. She enters his virtual reality to revive him through shared memories, but becomes trapped in an Old Western VR world.

results.title: Romanchakam
results.overview: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

results.title: Satan - The Dark
results.overview: Set in the fictional village of Asthinapuram, near Tamil Nadu–Kerala border, When Alisha and her mother desperate to escape the cursed land long belongs to colonial-era witchcraft and black magic, they find themselves spiraling into a deeper sinister. With only Alisha’s boyfriend standing by them, the trio must confront the horrors that dwell in silence… and the curse that refuses to be outrun.

results.title: Holy Days
results.overview: When young Brian discovers plans to close a convent of delightfully eccentric nuns, he sets off with them on a wild road trip across New Zealand to save their home.

results.title: Vanilla
results.overview: In the late 80s Mexico, a family made up of seven women from different generations and ideologies fights to save the house in which they live and which they are about to lose due to an outstanding debt. We see the story through the eyes of the youngest, Roberta (8), as she embarks on a journey of self-discovery, which impacts the rest of the family.

results.title: Collapse
results.overview: When the power goes out and all exits mysteriously seal shut, shoppers and employees find themselves trapped inside a Puerto Rico shopping mall with no communication to the outside world. As uncertainty turns to desperation, what begins as confusion rapidly descends into chaos. With limited food supplies and no answers, strangers must choose between cooperation and survival at any cost. In the darkness, civilized society collapses in mere hours, revealing the fragile line between order and anarchy. A post-apocalyptic thriller that unfolds entirely within the claustrophobic confines of a mall, where the real horror isn't what's outside—it's what emerges from within.

results.title: Ghermez Yavash
results.overview: The story is about a Russian girl who travels to Iran after her father goes missing, but in the meantime, her acquaintance with a boy in the south of Tehran gets her involved in a new adventure.

results.title: Compostelle
results.overview: Fred and Adam have nothing in common. Yet, they will meet while walking the Way of St. James as a form of spiritual path.

results.title: Daayra
results.overview: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

results.title: A Very Unlikely Goalkeeper
results.overview: Martín, a humble teenager with extraordinary talent as a goalkeeper, dreams of becoming a professional footballer. Facing rejection and bullying for his singular way of seeing the world, he must rely on his eccentric neighborhood friends to navigate his challenges and seize the one chance he has to turn his dream into reality.

results.title: Hunting Matthew Nichols
results.overview: Twenty-three years after her brother mysteriously disappeared on Vancouver Island, a documentary filmmaker sets out to solve his missing person's case. When a disturbing piece of evidence is revealed, she comes to believe he might still be alive.

results.title: Orion
results.overview: A NASA interrogator is tasked with helping an amnesiac astronaut recover his memory in order to determine “who” or “what” killed the rest of the crew before they crash-landed back on Earth.

results.title: Collective Unconscious
results.overview: Billy, an aspiring artist and musician, grapples with the challenges of growing up, navigating heartbreak, anxiety, and a myriad of nightmares. His quest leads him on a surreal odyssey through his dreams, where he seeks to unravel the deeper significance of his many concerns.

results.title: Anomie
results.overview: Zaara, a relentless sister seeking answers in her brother's unresolved case, confronts a police officer after days of failed investigation. As faith in the system erodes, she pursues the truth on parallel paths, leading to a haunting revelation.

results.title: Love, Again
results.overview: Caroline and Henry's 30-year marriage faces upheaval when he's diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. As Henry's memory deteriorates, Caroline finds comfort in friendship with Leo while coping with losing her partner.

results.title: Discounters XL
results.overview: When small-time online scammer Soufian is forced to take a job at the Super XL supermarket to pay off his debts, he uncovers a plan to replace the staff with automated self-checkout systems. What starts as a quick-money scheme turns into an unexpected rebellion, as the store’s eccentric shelf stackers refuse to be made obsolete.

results.title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
results.original_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
results.overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

results.title: Bigfoot I Love You
results.overview: When two young filmmakers search for Bigfoot in the forests of Normandy, they first must get through the crazy French townspeople who guard his secret.

results.title: What Lies Between Us
results.overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

results.title: Bunny!!
results.overview: A host of a relationship advice television programme starts to see cracks in her own marriage after the appearance of a mysterious guest.
